<lanc...@delphi.com> wrote:
>Does this card untap the vampire, or is it only usable by a tapped vampire
>which has some other way of untapping?...

Domain untaps the vampire and thus allows it to attempt to block, with the
benefit of the +2 intercept.

>as long as I'm asking; does ELDER KINDRED NETWORK have no effect if the vote
>passes, or does it have the effect of causing the successful vote to have no
>effect?...

If the vote passes, then the Elder Network doesn't cause any pool to be
lost; the vote still "works" normally.
